Date: Mon, 28 May 2028 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: urgent: large latency & 5xx spike impacting CedarCore checkout

Evelyn / Marissa — quick triage notes:
- Root cause (prelim): sudden batching configuration mismatch after an autoscaler event. Some inference workers reverted to a legacy batching profile causing excessive queueing under the known 200–400 req/sec load spike.
- Observable impact: KV cache churn and prolonged token decode times.
- Containment performed: rolled forward the patched batching profile, forced node drain on the affected pool, and warmed caches — latency normalized ~09:20.

Attaching the initial telemetry snapshot and a small script we ran to validate. Will work the deeper trace-level RCA and quantify error attribution.

Jonas
Jonas Weber
SRE Lead, Serving Runtime

Subject: Exec summary & approvals needed — CedarCore incident (May 28)

Team / Alex —

Executive summary (TL;DR):
- Impact window: 08:45–09:20 PDT on 2028-05-28.
- Customer-visible: increased checkout failures for ~12% of CedarCore production traffic during the window.
- Technical root cause: autoscaler-triggered node replacement + fallback to legacy batching profile (batch size misalignment) that caused queueing and KV cache misses.
- Containment: patched profile rolled forward and affected nodes drained; caches warmed; service returned to normal.

Approvals requested:
1) Commercial: ok to offer the proposed 3% usage credit (Ben) or prefer alternative?
2) Ops: approval to schedule the mandatory runtime config rollout Thursday 22:00–23:00 PDT (Jonas) — expected 10–15 minute maintenance with rolling restarts.

Proposed next steps (high level):
- Today: finalize RCA and send to customer (Marissa).
- Thu: runtime config rollout and post-rollout verification (Jonas + SRE).
- Fri: post-rollout metrics check and close loop with CedarCore execs.

Attached: remediation-timeline.xlsx (detailed owners & milestones).

Evelyn Hart
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
